query.description: Search query in Ukrainian (e.g., 'як утворюється минулий час')

subject.description: Optional canonical textbook subject slug. Examples: 'ukrmova', 'ukrlit', 'istoriya', 'bukvar'.

include_superseded.description: Explicitly include retained superseded transcriptions (default false).

source_file.description: Optional exact textbook source file to scope the search.

words.description: List of Ukrainian word forms to verify (e.g., ['кращий', 'гірший', 'більший'])

pos_filter.description: Optional POS filter applied to all words (e.g., 'adj', 'noun').

word.description: Ukrainian word to check: bare lemma, inflected form, or U+0301/U+0300-marked form (e.g., 'замок', 'любов'ю', 'за́мок')

lemma.description: Optional lemma; a source-stressed lemma distinguishes lexical homographs.

pos.description: Optional POS to help disambiguate a heteronym (e.g. 'NOUN' or 'upos=NOUN').

tags.description: Optional additional dictionary tags to help disambiguate, comma-separated (e.g. 'Case=Nom,Gender=Masc') — same vocabulary as each match's required_tags.

topic.description: Topic keyword (e.g., 'апостроф', 'м’який знак', 'у-в', 'подвоєння', 'велика буква', 'префікси') or § number as string (e.g., '7' or '§ 82')

query.description: Ukrainian phrase or word to check for calques/Russianisms
